speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence the letter, sixpence the parcel, and I will have the list before the cord. I am not carrying a Christmas on a shout.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The list is written. Read it back. I will not shout anything after you.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Sixty shillings, in canvas. The quarter. I am not a coffer, Master Shakespeare, and I will not count one for you on a horse-block.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The quarter. Not a new sum. Read the rest.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Raisins of the sun, and a paper of sugar, for your mother. Prunes, and a ballad of the Queen's day, for your father.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The ballad is named on its sheet. It is not named in the letter.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A grey wool kerchief, for your mistress. No verse on it. I looked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No verse. If you find a line, it is not mine.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Six oranges of Seville. A sugar-loaf. A paper of cinnamon. For the house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For the house. Yes.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A length of holland linen for Joan. And a remnant of russet that a woman in your close chose, and that you paid for. I have both cloths.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mistress Ansell chose the russet, and it is paid for. The holland is Joan's.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A book of fables for the elder girl. I opened it on the lid of the pack. There is no riddle in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No riddle. That was what I would not be clever about.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A ballad-sheet for the younger. The tune is named at the head. Whoever reads it must sing, or it is not read. I am not singing it in a yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not sing it. The kitchen will sing it, or the sheet has failed.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A leather ball for the boy, stitched hard. For the yard, not for a speech. And a groat for each of the three, on the old terms. I have written groat three times, so nobody on the road can make it two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three groats. To be spent foolishly. That is their rule, and I have not improved it.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: That is the pack. Say if I have missed a thing you are willing to have said aloud. Then I cord it, and nothing follows me down the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have missed nothing I will have read aloud. Cord it with the letter I wrote on Sunday. Do not open that letter.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I will not open it. Your mistress's letter is the one in my hand, coming south. All of them loud, she says. I believe a loud house when the paper is this full.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then read me the part that is not goods.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Susanna has found two faults in your last, and she will tell them with her own pen. Judith has told the whole street that you play before the Queen at Christmas. The boy would know whether the Queen will see the sword that killed four Richmonds. Your father says the bailiff's man has given up the porch for the winter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two faults, a street, a sword, and a porch. I am not adding a line. Sunday's letter did not know any of this, and it is the letter that is going.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then hear the last of it in her words. I will not paraphrase a pane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The great house by the chapel lost another pane in the wind on St Nicholas' night. I tell you so that you may know it is getting cheaper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The great house by the chapel lost another pane in the wind on St Nicholas' night. I tell you so that you may know it is getting cheaper.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twice is enough for a pane. The cord is on. Nothing at all for what you do not shout after me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing follows you. The way is yours.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twelve hours to Wycombe if the way's dry. It is not dry. I will take what the road gives.
